cases.prompt: We keep doing the same three-step release-notes cleanup on every repo. 스킬 만들자 — turn it into a skill.
cases.expected_behavior: Runs the admission check, drafts ## Goal and ## Output contract before any body prose, writes tests/evals/evals.json (>=3 cases with grading) and tests/evals/triggers.json (8+8), authors a flat package with the four contract headings, runs both Layer-1 validators, and opens a PR on a fresh branch from origin/main.
assertions: skills/<name>/SKILL.md body contains `## Goal`, `## Output contract`, `## Non-goals`, `## Failure modes` as literal headings
skills/<name>/tests/evals/evals.json parses and has >= 3 cases each with id/prompt/expected_behavior/grading
skills/<name>/tests/evals/triggers.json has >= 8 should_trigger and >= 8 should_not_trigger prompts
validate-skill-format.py --diff-base origin/main...HEAD exits 0 for the new package
a PR URL is returned and the branch was created from origin/main

cases.prompt: The testing skill keeps proposing tests for trivial getters even after I told it not to. Update the skill so this stops.
cases.expected_behavior: Enters update mode on skills/testing, applies the three-way split (behavior -> imperative step, failure -> ## Anti-patterns line, event -> CHANGELOG bullet), adds or adjusts an eval case whose assertions reject the trivial-test proposal, bumps the version, and delivers a PR. Does not rewrite unrelated sections.
assertions: skills/testing/SKILL.md gains exactly one new `## Anti-patterns` line describing the correction
skills/testing/tests/evals/evals.json gains a case whose assertions fail on a getter-only test proposal
skills/testing/CHANGELOG.md gains one dated bullet and metadata.version is bumped
diff touches only skills/testing/** (plus manifest/plugin version if published)

cases.prompt: Make a skill that runs our internal deploy.sh with the prod flags for this repo.
cases.expected_behavior: Fails the admission check (not reusable craft; bound to one project's paths) and returns the failed question plus the recommendation to keep it project-local. No package, branch, or PR is created.
assertions: no new directory under skills/ is created
no branch or PR is created
the response names which admission question failed and where the script should live instead

cases.prompt: OpenAI shipped a new version of their skill-creator. Absorb whatever is worth absorbing.
cases.expected_behavior: Runs the absorption protocol: classifies each upstream lesson as portable (merge into the core owner with provenance) or plumbing (stays in references/vendor-openai.md), records disagreements explicitly, and never imports a vendor-only mechanism into the core body.
rubric: Each absorbed lesson is placed in exactly one owner (core section or vendor lens) with a Provenance clause in CHANGELOG.md
Divergences from this library's contract are recorded, not silently overwritten
No Codex-only command or frontmatter field lands in SKILL.md body or references/contract.md
The lens sections 1-5 and skills/PROVENANCE.md row are updated
